Problem Statement
Write a program that reads an integer and performs various checks to classify the number.
Description
Read an integer and perform the following operations:
Check whether the number is positive, negative, or zero.
Check whether the number is even or odd.
Calculate the square of the number.
Calculate the cube of the number.
Display all results in the specified format.
Sample Input
5

Number Type: Positive
Parity: Odd
Square: 25
Cube: 125
